==Description==
The '''Easter Egg''' is a consumable which applies a random temporary buff to any tower. It was exclusively obtained from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]].

Only up to five '''Easter Eggs''' can be used in a single match. Each '''Easter Egg''' has a 5 second cooldown before it can be used again, and a 10 second initial cooldown applied at the beginning of the match.

==Usage==
When thrown, the '''Easter Egg''' will apply a random buff to any tower hit. Theses buffs can be a 30% [[Range Buff]], a 30% [[Firerate Buff]] or being granted hidden detection, each one lasting 20 seconds. If a tower already has hidden detection, the third buff will not be applied and the game will not apply any different buff, meaning nothing happens.

The buff that is applied is not the same per throw and is instead random per tower. For example, if five different towers are caught in its explosion, each one will have a different buff applied.

==Appearance==
The '''Easter Egg''' is a decorated green egg held by the player in its hands. It creates a large green explosion upon hitting the ground.

==Strategy==
*The '''Easter Egg''' can be used to quickly buff a tower.
**However, due to the buffs being inconsistent, players may be recommended to bring the [[Cooldown Flag]], [[Range Flag]] or [[UAV]] instead due to them offering the same buffs more consistently, albeit with a higher cooldown.
